bugs_discovered_and_resolved.description: Snippet-Only False Research: Native tool deep_research returned raw DuckDuckGo snippet bodies without reading actual pages.
bugs_discovered_and_resolved.repair: Routed tool call through DeepResearchEngine with fetch_page_content_detailed, requiring >=50 chars for verification.

bugs_discovered_and_resolved.description: SSRF vulnerability: native tool web_fetch used raw httpx without IP/subnet filtering.
bugs_discovered_and_resolved.repair: Replaced with guarded web_fetch using is_safe_url, _NO_REDIRECT_OPENER, and prompt delimiters.

bugs_discovered_and_resolved.description: Model Architecture: Silent fallback to hard-coded llama3.2:1b during synthesis errors.
bugs_discovered_and_resolved.repair: Dynamically resolved user-selected model from settings (qwen3.5:9b); compile honest fallback report from verified citations without model switching.

bugs_discovered_and_resolved.description: Prompt Injection: Web snippet text was placed unshielded in synthesis user prompt.
bugs_discovered_and_resolved.repair: Wrapped source context in PROMPT_DELIMITER_START / PROMPT_DELIMITER_END and appended explicit security directives.

bugs_discovered_and_resolved.description: False Success on 100% Unverified Pages: If all pages failed to load, worker attempted to synthesize claims from snippets.
bugs_discovered_and_resolved.repair: Enforced zero-source fail-closed check halting with TaskState.FAILED and honest inconclusive report.
